source_name: Az én pénzem (azenpenzem.hu) — consumer-finance news on new payment-market entrants
why_relevant: Covers licence grants and market entries in plain HU — e.g. an item on a foreign-backed fintech (Pay10) obtaining an MNB electronic money institution licence. Licence-grant news is one of the earliest verifiable signals of a new payment competitor before it has any volume.

source_name: Bank360.hu blog — retail banking/card market commentary
why_relevant: Comparison-site editorial that reports award results, fee changes and card-product launches with concrete figures; a cheap secondary confirmation layer for award and product signals.

source_name: Bank corporate newsrooms as award/roadmap disclosure channel (OTP, Gránit, K&H, Raiffeisen, MagNet)
why_relevant: Banks self-publish award wins, product launches, ATM-network changes and partnership announcements with quantified claims (user counts, transaction growth). Combined with the award and conference calendar this gives a per-institution weak-signal timeline; OTP Mobile and Raiffeisen are already named as qvik sub-aggregators.

source_name: 10times.com — Hungary business/finance event calendar (incl. International Payment Forum, Budapest)
why_relevant: Aggregator that catches smaller or vendor-run Budapest payments events not covered by Portfolio or Fintechzone (e.g. an International Payment Forum listing). Useful purely as a discovery net for new event brands; details must be verified on the organiser's own site.

source_name: The Paypers — annual payments & fintech events calendar
why_relevant: Curated international event calendar; identifies the regional (CEE/EU) events where Hungarian banks, GIRO and MNB staff speak and where HU-relevant scheme roadmaps (IPR, ISO 20022, wallets) are presented.

source_name: XXII. E-Kereskedelmi Konferencia (Hungarian e-commerce conference)
why_relevant: Merchant-side event where online payment acceptance, qvik and card-vs-cash-on-delivery economics are discussed by the merchants and PSPs themselves — the demand side of card/POS statistics, and a recruiting ground for merchant-level human sources.

source_name: MNB Statisztika – Pénzforgalmi adatok / Archív tartalmak
why_relevant: Official MNB landing page that explicitly collects DISCONTINUED payment time series for 2001-2013: chip migration data, interbank payment and clearing system turnover, 'Fizetési kártya üzletág Magyarországon' (card business incl. ATM/POS acceptance network), card fraud, and EU cross-border payment customer information. These series were removed from the live statistical tables and exist only here.

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine – mnb.hu / statisztika.mnb.hu captures
why_relevant: MNB migrated its statistics from mnb.hu to statisztika.mnb.hu and renumbered table sets; Wayback captures of the old mnb.hu/statisztika pages preserve dead XLS links and the original table numbering/metadata needed to stitch pre- and post-migration card/ATM/POS series.

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine – giro.hu captures (BKR turnover statistics)
source_subtype: general web archive of an infrastructure operator
why_relevant: GIRO republishes monthly BKR turnover PDFs under rotating storage URLs and prunes older ones; Wayback is the practical way to recover the withdrawn monthly BKR transaction-count series that underpins HU electronic credit-transfer volume history.

source_name: GIRO Zrt. dokumentumtár / elszámolásforgalmi dokumentumok (live BKR statistics repository)
why_relevant: Operator-published BKR (Bankközi Klíring Rendszer) monthly turnover PDFs and IG1/IG2 standard volume archives — the pointer set that must be mirrored before files rotate out.

source_name: KSH STADAT archívum (archived summary-table system)
why_relevant: The STADAT table system was rebuilt on 2021-04-06; the archive holds the pre-2021 table structure and discontinued tables, including finance/monetary and retail-turnover tables that carry card and cash-usage context. Old table IDs cited in older literature only resolve here.

source_name: KSH évkönyvek (statistical yearbooks) via the KSH Library
why_relevant: Magyar statisztikai évkönyv / statisztikai zsebkönyv volumes carry finance chapters with historical payment, cash-in-circulation and card indicators in a fixed, citable form that survives web-table restructuring.

source_name: Arcanum ADT – Magyar Statisztikai Évkönyv 1871–1990 digitised collection
why_relevant: Full-text digitised run of the Hungarian Statistical Yearbook produced with KSH and the KSH Library; the only practical machine-searchable route to pre-1990 monetary circulation / savings / payment-instrument baselines used for long-run cash-usage framing.

source_name: Hungaricana Közgyűjteményi Portál
why_relevant: Aggregates NKA-funded library/archive/museum digitisation (operated by the Parliamentary Library, built by Arcanum); a pointer to digitised official gazettes and institutional yearbooks that contain historical banking/payment ordinances and statistics.

source_name: OSZK Webarchívum (Hungarian national web archive)
why_relevant: National Széchényi Library web-archiving programme with domain-scale Hungarian harvests (≈29 TB, ~500M URLs by 2019) plus curated site lists — the local complement to the Internet Archive for HU bank, MNB and fintech pages that Wayback captured thinly.

source_name: Nemzeti Közadatportál (National Public Data Portal)
why_relevant: Official public-data cadastre listing registers and databases held by Hungarian state bodies; used to discover that a payment/banking dataset exists at MNB, KSH, NAV or a ministry even when no public download page does.

source_name: opendata.gov.hu – igényelhető közadatok kereső
why_relevant: Catalogue of requestable public datasets organised by governmental function; the formal route to request non-published HU financial/payment datasets and to see which bodies hold them.

source_name: Közadatkereső (kozadat.hu) – public-data metadata search
why_relevant: Statutory metadata search operated under the NISZ Közadat programme; indexes document type, creation date and web address of published public-interest data from thousands of Hungarian bodies — useful for locating URLs of publications that have since disappeared from publisher sites.

source_name: OpenData.hu – civil Hungarian open-data catalogue
why_relevant: NGO/volunteer-built CKAN-style catalogue that has historically hosted scraped copies of Hungarian public datasets, including ones later withdrawn by the original publisher.

source_name: ECB Data Portal – Payments and Settlement Systems Statistics (discontinued) [PSS]
why_relevant: The retired ECB Blue Book / PSS dataset carries harmonised Hungarian card, ATM, POS terminal and payment-instrument series for the pre-2014 definitions that MNB no longer publishes. Explicitly flagged discontinued and reachable only via the ECB Data Portal API, so it must be pulled deliberately.

source_name: ECB Data Portal – Payment card functions / PAY & PST current datasets
why_relevant: The successor datasets to PSS; needed as the bridging reference when reconstructing a continuous HU card/ATM/POS series across the 2014 methodology break.

source_name: data.europa.eu – Hungary country page and HU dataset harvest
why_relevant: The EU aggregator harvests Hungarian national portal metadata; its records often survive after the national portal reorganises, giving a recoverable dataset identifier and description for HU financial datasets.

source_name: Dateno registry – Hungary data catalogs index
why_relevant: Third-party registry enumerating Hungarian data catalogues (including the National Public Data Portal) with catalogue-level metadata — a fast way to snowball into HU portals that do not rank in ordinary search.

source_name: DataPortals.org – opendata-hu entry
why_relevant: Long-standing portal directory that preserves descriptions and URLs of Hungarian open-data portals, including defunct ones — useful for reconstructing where HU datasets used to live.

source_name: KSH sajtószoba – közlemények, tájékoztatók archívum
why_relevant: Archive of KSH releases and 'gyorstájékoztató' notices; the release text frequently states methodology breaks and discontinuations that explain why a payment/retail series changed or vanished, and preserves headline numbers for withdrawn tables.

source_name: KSH Statisztikai Szemle archívum
why_relevant: Peer-reviewed statistical journal archive; articles on Hungarian payment habits, cash usage and card penetration typically reprint series (with sources) that are no longer downloadable, and document methodology histories.

source_name: MNB pénzforgalmi infrastruktúra pages on mnb.hu (legacy narrative + legacy links)
why_relevant: The mnb.hu (non-statistics) payment section still carries legacy descriptive pages and links to older reports/datasets; combined with Wayback captures it is the index for locating pre-migration MNB payment publications.
